title: Cyberpunk 2077's Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) is out now!
raw: [p]In the City of (Broken) Dreams, it’s not about how you flatline. What matters most is the impact you make with the time you’re given. [/p][p][/p][p]So how will you seize the new opportunities awaiting for you in Night City? [/p][p][/p][p]Check out the launch trailer celebrating both the second installment in the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners anime series, available now on Netflix, as well as Cyberpunk 2077 and its newly released update, featuring content inspired by the show.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hylmr-LlFtE;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Learn more about the new content and features the Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) introduces to the game in the official patch notes:[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/1091500/announcements/detail/671757730685388198"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]
